title: gaultheria costaricensis
intro: Gaultheria costaricensis, commonly known as Costa Rican wintergreen, is a plant species belonging to the heath family (Ericaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from pain, inflammation, and stress. The health benefits of Gaultheria costaricensis are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include methyl salicylate, which is a key compound responsible for its medicinal properties.
